title: Refresh the pinned Product entry after each merge
body:
Since t-z1rn4s0 a forwarded `krn task` exits 78 when `.krn/product-release` lags the local `origin/main`, so every merge needs a manual `scripts/product-release.sh`. Refresh it where the lead already observes the merge (e.g. `krn ci wait` on MERGED), checking the candidate first and recording the previous commit for rollback (RD04 in .krn/runs/lead/t3code-agentic/lanes/t3-rules-docs.md).
Acceptance: after `krn ci wait` reports a merge, `bin/krn doctor` prints status=fresh without a manual step; a failed refresh leaves the previous commit and prints it.
